		const inner_idx = ${n}&0b11111;
		const outer_idx = ${n}>>5;
		const low = ${t} << inner_idx;
		${e}.data[outer_idx] |= low;
		if (inner_idx > 27) {//32 - inner_idx > 5
			const high = ${t} >> (32 - inner_idx);
			${e}.data[outer_idx+1] |= high;
		}
	}`}BitVec.prototype.ishiftclear=function(e,t){const n=t&31,i=t>>5,o=e<<n;if(this.data[i]&=~o,n>27){const s=e>>32-n;this.data[i+1]&=~s}};function WEIRDNESS_FOUND(e){throw new Error(`found ${e}`)}function ISHIFTCLEAR(e,t,n){const i=n&31,o=n>>5,s=t+"<<"+i;let l=`${e}.data[${o}] &= ~(${s});
